speakers.title: The Voices We Bring In
speakers.intro: Real people. Real stories. Real conversations. We invite people with experiences, knowledge, and stories that can help Bloomies think, learn, ask questions, and see new possibilities.

whatWeLookFor.title: Experience
whatWeLookFor.description: People who can bring real experiences, knowledge, lessons, skills, or perspectives to the conversation.

whatWeLookFor.title: Honesty
whatWeLookFor.description: We value conversations that feel human. Speakers do not need to have every answer or a perfect story.

whatWeLookFor.title: Connection
whatWeLookFor.description: The best conversations leave girls feeling seen, encouraged, curious, or ready to take their next step.

topicAreas.title: Confidence & Identity
topicAreas.description: Conversations about knowing yourself, confidence, identity, self-expression, and becoming.

topicAreas.title: Education & Careers
topicAreas.description: School, career exploration, opportunities, navigating choices, and preparing for the future.

topicAreas.title: Leadership & Voice
topicAreas.description: Finding your voice, leading with purpose, speaking up, and making an impact.

topicAreas.title: Wellness & Life
topicAreas.description: Emotional wellness, relationships, everyday life, personal growth, and honest conversations.

topicAreas.title: Technology & Creativity
topicAreas.description: Technology, digital skills, creativity, innovation, and exploring what girls can build.

topicAreas.title: Anything Girls Want to Ask
topicAreas.description: Sometimes the most important topic is simply the question a girl has been wanting to ask.

session.name: Guest Conversation
session.topicSelection: Topics are shaped by the girls and the conversations they want to have.

structure.description: Girls join the session, settle in, and get introduced to the conversation.
The main conversation, stories, questions, lessons, and shared experiences.
Bloomies get space to ask questions and close out the session together.

forSpeakers.title: Bring your experience
forSpeakers.description: Come with the lessons, knowledge, stories, and experiences that can add something meaningful to the conversation.

forSpeakers.title: Make room for questions
forSpeakers.description: The girls are not just an audience. Their questions, curiosity, and experiences are part of the conversation.

forSpeakers.title: Leave something behind
forSpeakers.description: We hope every conversation leaves Bloomies with something to think about, try, remember, or carry forward.

speakerInterest.heading: Want to speak with the Bloomies?
speakerInterest.description: If you have a story, skill, experience, or perspective you think girls would benefit from, we would love to hear from you.
